topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I stepped into the attic, the old floorboards creaking under my feet, the air thick with the scent of dust and forgotten time. I hadn’t planned on exploring this space anytime soon, but the need to clear out seemed urgent. As my flashlight cut through the darkness, I stumbled upon boxes and trunks, their contents unfamiliar and unsettling. Old photographs, their faces staring back at me with unspoken stories; clothes that seemed to belong to another era, still folded as if waiting for the next day to come. Each item felt like a piece of a puzzle I didn’t want to solve, each shadow a reminder of what I hoped to leave undisturbed. I moved slowly, each step heavier than the last, the weight of the unknown pressing down on me.
